verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs and GitHub describe scraping dynamic content, clicking/filling forms, and a managed 'Browser Sandbox' for interactive workflows, and a community comment confirms it uses a headless browser (Puppeteer) to render pages, supporting JS-heavy SPA rendering. However, other community feedback notes limitations (e.g., daemon mode not returning HTML, no proxy service, uncertainty handling CSR-only sites), suggesting inconsistent reliability for full JS rendering at scale.
